manual: Build with community-apps/signed/install.sh. qmake6 from Devuan Excalibur (Qt 6.8) is enough; the Arch qt6-wayland package is not used.
Placed text is measured in Noto Sans (fonts-noto-core) and embedded in the PDF.
Digital seals use Poppler's NSS backend (libnss3). Certificates stay in ~/.local/share/signed/certificates/.
The file dialog needs the GTK xdg-desktop-portal backend. Signed is registered for PDFs but is not made the default viewer.
Hyprland corner rounding is skipped when HYPRLAND_INSTANCE_SIGNATURE is unset, so corners stay square on i3.
